title: LEWIS: Consistent DAG Selection for Bayesian Causal Discovery
description: R package for learning a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from observational data that follow a linear structural equation model in which each error may be Gaussian or a Gaussian scale mixture. LEWIS (Laplace Error Working model for Inference and Selection of DAG) uses a Laplace working likelihood at every node, a complexity prior on the graph and a Laplace approximation of the marginal likelihood, samples DAGs with a Metropolis-Hastings algorithm, and summarizes the draws by a point estimate of the distribution equivalence class, a credible ball and posterior probabilities of edges and of non-Gaussian errors. The repository includes the scripts that reproduce the simulations, figures and tables of the accompanying methods paper.
